TMPDIR=<private> STRATEGIES=dead_run SEEDS="1 4" EXTRA="--permit=2 --skill-order=B1,C1,A1,M1,M2,F1,C3 --inject=15:1500" TAG=fast LIMIT=180 sh qa/bots/run_batch.sh <out>  (seed 1: cash 144 flat cycles 21 to 30; seed 4: cash 144 flat from cycle 23)
Read cash_by_cycle and plate_log in RESULT: routes 'Not enough cash.' for 2 running routes (reserve_short cash 146 vs fixed 104 x 2), dross source stock grows each cycle (free dead-world mining)
expected: Cash changes or the player can act (sell stock, close a route) while routes are open
actual: Cash is flat for 7 to 10 cycles to the end with no income. Routes stall on cash below one trip plus upkeep. The bot never sells the dross it holds at the station (only plate has a sell order now). The bot's idle check counts source stock growth as progress, so the run is not flagged as a softlock (see BR-06). Human exit (Sell dross at Voltara, or Remove a route) not probed: UNKNOWN.

steps: TMPDIR=<private> STRATEGIES=dead_run SEEDS="1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8" EXTRA="--permit=2 --skill-order=B1,C1,A1,M1,M2,F1,C3 --inject=15:1500" TAG=fast LIMIT=180 sh qa/bots/run_batch.sh <out>
Read fabric_state, plate_log, core_log, dead_log (cycle 15 rows)
expected: Fabric makes plate from dross and nullglass; Null Core built and fitted; plate sold at Voltara
actual: Plate max: 1 (seeds 2, 5, 7), 0 (seeds 1, 3, 4, 6, 8). Fabric built and then stalled in seeds 3, 4, 6, 8 (no input reaches the station). Seed 3 at cycle 15: 'No ship available. Buying one needs more cash.' for dead_1 and 'Routes between systems need Long Haul (C3).' for Greywake nullglass, with cash 11347 at end, so the cause is ship slots and C3 timing, not cash. Seeds 1 and 4 end at cash 144 (BR-01). Null Core built in 2 seeds (5, 7 at cycles 19 and 23, scripted chain) and fitted. Plate sell now works, so the output is measurable but tiny.
